newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Tech gets 1.5 bln ATS SAfrican order.
newsitem.headline: VA Tech gets 1.5 bln ATS SAfrican order.

text.p: VA Industrieanlagenbau (VAI), a unit of Austrian engineering group VA Technologie, said on Wednesday it had received a contract worth some 1.5 billion schillings to build a steelworks in South Africa.
The contract, from Duferco Steel Processing (Pty) Limited, is to build a cold steel strip processing plant at Saldanha in the Cape Province, VAI said in a statement.
Duferco Steel Processing is 50 percent owned by Duferco SA of Switzerland, and 50 percent by the Industrial Development Corporation of South Africa Limited.
VAI will build a cold mill complex to process hot rolled coil from the nearby Saldanha steel facility to produce 610,000 tonnes per annum of finished product. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
